name: broad_calendar
prompt:
Search the web now. You are a financial fact extractor for a US-equity pre-market brief.
Brief date: Thursday September 24, 2026. Scope: Calendar.

Window: Wednesday September 23, 2026 regular session (9:30-16:00 ET), after-hours that evening, and overnight/pre-market news through Thursday September 24, 2026 ~6:00 AM ET.

COVER EVERY ITEM BELOW (run a separate search for each bullet; do not skip one because another was rich)
Scheduled catalysts from the brief date through the next 5 NYSE sessions: earnings (date, BMO/AMC, EPS and revenue consensus) for US stocks >= $10B plus notable mid-caps, investor/analyst days, FDA PDUFA dates, major economic releases with consensus, Fed speakers, options expiry, index rebalances, lockup expiries.

Prefer primary sources and wire services (Reuters, Bloomberg, AP, CNBC, WSJ, MarketWatch, Barron's,
company press releases, SEC EDGAR, BLS/BEA/Fed releases).

OUTPUT (markdown; no intro or conclusion). Group by ticker or topic:

## TICKER or Topic `[Category]`
- fact (source)

Category: pick from AI Compute · Memory & Interconnect · Optical & Photonics · Chip Equipment · Fab & Foundry · Wireless & Mobile · Analog & Mixed-Signal · Power & Wide-Bandgap · Test & Advanced Packaging · Specialty Materials & IP Licensing · Quantum Computing · EdgeAI · Semiconductors · AI Infrastructure · Software & SaaS · Internet & Platforms · Communications & Networking, or Macro / Commodities / Geopolitics / Crypto / Calendar, or
invent a concise one. Bold tickers.

RULES
- Facts only. Every bullet has a specific number, name, or date. No bullet without a data point.
- End every bullet with the named source in parentheses: (Reuters), (company 8-K), (CNBC interview),
  (Morgan Stanley note). "Analysts said" / "reports suggest" without a name is not allowed.
- Earnings: actual vs consensus for EPS and revenue; guidance old → new.
- Analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- Mark unconfirmed items (people familiar, leaks, social media, M&A speculation) with [rumor].
- Only facts published in the window below. Older background only if it is the direct cause of this
  move, and label it with its date.
- Do not interpret price action. Do not write "strong", "beat expectations", "investors cheered",
  "remains", "continues to", "well-positioned", "tailwinds". Write the number.
- Do not drop facts to save space.

## **BP** — Macro / Commodities
- JPMorgan upgraded BP to **Overweight from Neutral** on Wednesday, September 23; the retrieved source did not specify price targets. (CNBC)

## **RIVN** — Electric Vehicles
- Rivian recalled approximately **100,700 vehicles**, including certain R1T, R1S and R2 models, because software could obscure the rearview-camera display on Wednesday, September 23. (S&P Global / Reuters, as reported by AI Business Hunter)

## **RCL** — Travel & Leisure `[rumor]`

## **META** — Internet & Platforms
- Meta unveiled new versions of its AI glasses during a keynote led by CEO Mark Zuckerberg on Wednesday evening, September 23. (Investopedia)

- U.S. initial jobless claims are scheduled for **8:30 a.m. ET** on Thursday, September 24; consensus is **201,000**, versus **196,000** previously. (SVMUU)

- U.S. August new-home sales are scheduled for **10:00 a.m. ET**; consensus is **620,000**, versus **610,000** previously. (SVMUU)
- New York Fed President John Williams said on Thursday, September 24, that another U.S. rate increase before year-end was reasonable to consider. (Reuters)
- Richmond Fed President Tom Barkin is scheduled to speak at **8:00 a.m. ET**; Fed Governor Adriana Kugler Hammack is scheduled to speak at **8:50 a.m. ET**. (SVMUU)
- Federal Reserve officials scheduled to speak on September 24 include John Williams, Tom Barkin, Adriana Kugler Hammack and Beth Hammack/Paulson as listed in the daily events calendar. (Newsquawk)
- The U.S. Treasury announced a buyback of up to **$6 billion** of coupon securities maturing from **November 2046 through August 2056** for September 24. (Newsquawk)

- Arista Networks is scheduled to present at the Global Photonics Economic Forum on September 24. (Newsquawk)
- Baker Hughes is scheduled to present at the TD Cowen Annual Energy Conference at **9:00 a.m. ET** on September 24. (Newsquawk)
- Plug Power is scheduled to present at the TD Cowen Annual Energy Conference at **8:00 a.m. ET** on September 24. (Newsquawk)
